features.title: Initial Onboarding Tooltip Integration
features.desired_outcome: Display a brief introductory text box explaining walk and combat actions at the start of Moss Trail.
features.reason: Without onboarding prompts, new players must guess how movement and combat interactions work.

features.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
features.desired_outcome: An in-game collection menu tracking discovered items and rewarding completionists upon fully exploring a route catalog.
features.reason: Explorers and collectors desire an in-game tracking interface for unique route items and completion rewards.

features.title: Exploration-Themed Route Modifiers and Revisit Incentives
features.desired_outcome: Introduce periodic 'Forager's Moon' or discovery weather modifiers that increase rare collectible drop rates on specific older routes.
features.reason: Once a route like Gloomwood is beaten, there are limited gameplay reasons to return without dynamic exploration events or bonus tokens.

features.title: Elite Combat Encounters & Aggressive Enemy Profiles
features.desired_outcome: Add tighter encounter spacing and content pack variants featuring aggressive enemy configurations on difficulty 3+ routes.
features.reason: Current routes feature very few encounters relative to movement steps, reducing the mechanical depth of combat.

features.title: Elite Cosmetic Savings Milestone Bonus
features.desired_outcome: Introduce a temporary marketplace bonus or loyalty discount tier when players retain a specific coin threshold, accelerating elite purchases.
features.reason: Currently, a single successful run leaves a wide deficit when aiming for high-end marketplace items after buying mid-tier gear.

features.title: Keyboard Shortcut Indicators in UI Menus
features.desired_outcome: Display clear hotkey badges next to interface buttons and marketplace actions.
features.reason: Clear visual prompts for key bindings reduce cognitive load and enhance mouse/keyboard usability.

features.title: Input Buffering for Obstacle Interaction
features.desired_outcome: Automatically buffer or prompt the correct jump input when a walk action is entered against a known hazard.
features.reason: Edge-case testing shows players frequently attempt to keep walking into obstacles before realizing a jump is required.

features.title: Elite Enemy Behavior Profiles for Difficulty 3+ Routes
features.reason: Combat challengers reported low enemy encounter density and mechanical friction on high-tier routes.

features.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
features.reason: First-time players need welcome tooltips at step 0 to understand initial movement and combat mechanics.

features.title: High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States
features.reason: Accessibility council noted that marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.

features.title: Movement Command Validation & Obstacle Input Buffering
features.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows redundant walk commands attempting to queue against active hazard collisions.

policy.note: AI beta-test recommendations are advisory. The owner manually implements changes with ChatGPT and uses Development Review only to monitor status.
